replacements.instruction: Rendered paragraph endingで `Single-pass.` だけが次行に残るruntを解消するため、sensitivity文を意味を変えずに局所短縮する。resource-matchedの方向、cross-familyの不安定さ、WritingBenchでのSingle-pass比較の反転という3点は保持する。
replacements.before: See Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity-analyses} for sensitivity analyses: resource-matched comparisons largely preserve the direction, whereas cross-family rescoring is less stable and reverses the WritingBench direction against \condSinglePass.
replacements.after: See Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity-analyses} for sensitivity analyses: resource-matched comparisons largely preserve the direction, whereas cross-family rescoring is less stable, including a WritingBench reversal against \condSinglePass.
